name: Wireless Network Simulation Benchmark Data
description: Provides simulated wireless network data intended as benchmark datasets for training and evaluating machine learning models on networking tasks.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (RMSE/MAE for regression and forecasting; accuracy/F1 for classification; task_success_rate or domain-specific throughput/latency metrics for RL/resource-allocation)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (RMSE/MAE for regression tasks; accuracy/F1 for classification; throughput/latency for network performance tasks)
reputation: An academic benchmark introduced in an IEEE Globecom publication; respected in networking research circles but not widely used outside specialized wireless ML communities.
notes: Simulated data — may not fully reflect real-world wireless environments (domain gap). Benchmark is non-LLM and focused on networking modalities; dataset scale and task definitions vary by use case.
